product_summary: Ahmedabad (Gujarat) manufacturer of flexible packaging and technical plastics, established 1987. Real product lines per own catalogue (singhalindustries.co.in, IndiaMART storefront): HDPE sheets (1-100 mm, 1220x2440 mm), HDPE geomembrane/pond liner (100-2000 microns), LDPE polythene sheet, PP sheets and PP corrugated sheets (0.5-1.5 mm), HIPS sheet & roll, ABS sheet, polycarbonate/multiwall sheet, recycled plastic sheets, EVA granules, HDPE granules, PP woven sacks, FIBC/jumbo bags (incl. 1250 kg 4-panel baffle bag), PP leno mesh bags, garbage bags, bulk container liner, PP woven fabric roll, PET spunbond nonwoven, geotextile, biaxial geogrid, geocell, drainage geonet, silt fence, weed control mat, warning tape/mesh, cable protection cover, rockshield pipe protection net, stretch film, greenhouse film, plastic crates, plant grow bags, tree guard, synthetic roofing underlayment.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared manufacturer with in-house extrusion; IndiaMART 'Verified Exporter' badge and IEC listed on profile — export activity itself not verified in this HS-only review). Note: a separate, unrelated Delhi engineering firm also trades as 'Singhal Industries' (CNC turned parts, deep-drawn components, aluminium forgings, sheet metal) — name collision risk when matching the legal entity.
comment: Declared 392020 + 392099 are correct but cover only a fraction of the real range. 3920.20 is fully corroborated (PP sheets, PP corrugated sheet, PP sheet & board). 3920.99 is corroborated (HIPS sheet/roll, ABS sheet, polycarbonate sheet). The dominant line — HDPE/LDPE sheet, geomembrane, pond liner, film — belongs to 3920.10, which is MISSING from the declaration and should be added as the primary code. Also missing: 3923.21/3923.29/3923.30 (woven sacks, FIBC, leno bags, liners — a major revenue line), 3923.90 (crates, grow bags), 3926.90 (geogrid/geocell/geonet/weed mat/warning tape), 5407.20 & 5603.13 (PP woven fabric, PET spunbond), 3901.10/3901.20 (HDPE/EVA granules — raw-material trade, note trader element). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification: the company is a plastics converter / flexible-packaging manufacturer (plastics & packaging), not oil-gas or chemicals; petrochemical feedstock only as granules. All product data is from the company's own website and IndiaMART catalogue — no customs line was available in this review, so every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, codes corrected to actual, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
